en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a railway line curving into a stone tunnel beneath a townscape. The scene shows tracks descending between high retaining walls into a masonry tunnel portal. Above and around the tunnel are multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs, a tall industrial chimney, flowering trees, and fenced gardens. A person in dark clothing stands with a dog on the path to the left. The sky is clear and blue. Printed red text labels the location and feature depicted.
